takes.h: King sells out St. Ann's in Brooklyn
takes.p: Stephen King will appear at St. Ann's Church in Brooklyn on November 4, hosted by Books Are Magic with Emma Straub. The event is sold out. His site says a free YouTube livestream is planned for those who cannot get a seat.

takes.h: The Restoration at Grayson Manor starts a theatrical tour
takes.p: Glenn McQuaid's The Restoration at Grayson Manor, with Chris Colfer and co-written by Clay McLeod Chapman, began a theatrical tour on October 9 at the Alamo Drafthouse Lower Manhattan, Rue Morgue reports.

takes.h: Jakks announces the Doll Haus of Dread
takes.p: Jakks is releasing “Doll Haus of Dread” fashion dolls of Pinhead, Jason Voorhees, Ghostface and Billy the Puppet, Bloody Disgusting reports. No release timing has been given.

takes.h: Barker: lifetime award and five Hellraiser one-shots
takes.p: Clive Barker's site reports that he will receive the World Fantasy Award for Lifetime Achievement, announced in August and to be presented later this year. It also notes that Boom! released five Hellraiser: Resurrections one-shots in September.
